description: Fires when the opponent threatens to win next move on top of column 6 (the rightmost column), most often because they just stacked three in column 6, but also horizontal/diagonal threats there; strongest with a single such threat. Does not fire for a threat in an empty column 6 (bottom row) or for my own threes. Weaker firing for an opponent vertical three just made in column 0, and occasionally near threshold for blocks in other columns.
effect: Pushes the move to column 6: forcing it high moves col 6 from ~0% to 88-97% in quiet positions; it does not override a genuine must-block elsewhere; zeroing it barely changes the (already certain) col-6 block.
notes: Best dev F1 0.626 (P 0.666, R 0.590, AUROC 0.79) with p5. Tried: vertical three col6/col0 (0.558), any-column vertical three (0.433), col-6 must-block any direction (0.567), single must-block col6/col0 (0.550). Minimal pairs: vertical col 6 threat 17-39; horizontal (1,6) threat 21-23 even when last move elsewhere; (0,6) threat ~0; middle-column verticals erratic (-0.4 to 3.4). Misses are mostly near-threshold blocks in other columns. Simulation share is undefined for this unit (perfect 10-level reader recovers -19.7%).
